evidence.title: cmux - The terminal built for multitasking
GitHub - manaflow-ai/cmux: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents

name: cmux
summary: Native macOS terminal built on Ghostty for running and supervising AI coding agents.
description: A native macOS terminal (Swift + AppKit, no Electron) built on libghostty, made for running many AI coding agents in parallel: vertical tabs and workspaces that show git branch, working directory and ports, notification rings when an agent needs attention, split panes and a scriptable in-app browser. Every action is available through a cmux CLI and a Unix socket API, so scripts and agents can drive the terminal itself. Free and open source with paid cloud plans.
contains: Native macOS terminal in Swift + AppKit on libghostty, no Electron
Vertical tabs and workspaces showing git branch, PR status, working directory and listening ports
Notification rings, unread badges, a notification panel and macOS notifications (OSC 9/99/777)
Scriptable via the cmux CLI and a Unix socket API: workspaces, panes, input, screenshots, browser
In-app browser pane with a scriptable automation API
Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Aider and any CLI tool
Free tier; Pro $40/mo, Max $160/mo, Team $60/user/mo, Enterprise custom; iOS companion in beta
